explanation: Fires only in the original phase and almost entirely at step t=2, the third original token: 93% of activations and 95% of the mass on dev. There is weak spillover at t=1 and t=3, and it never fires at t=0, at the delimiter or in the copy phase. But only ~12% of t=2 steps are active. Whether it fires, and how strongly, depends additively on the identities of the three tokens so far. First token b (7x lift), f or s; previous token b or f; current input f (5x), j or c. The strongest examples are b b [f], b f [f] and f b [f]. Low-quartile activations are at t=2 with tokens outside these sets, e.g. d k [n]. It is a graded, roughly additive token-identity score at position 2, so no single clean predicate gets high precision. The token-set predicate gets about 0.85 of the mass but only ~0.40 precision.
